title: Build a custom composite action reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for build a custom composite action should include: using: composite, inputs:, outputs:, action.yml.
answer.example:
# action.yml
name: Repository checks
description: Run shared, non-destructive checks
inputs:
  message:
    description: Status message
    required: false
    default: "Checks ready"
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Print status
      shell: bash
      env:
        MESSAGE: ${{ inputs.message }}
      run: echo "$MESSAGE"
answer.verification: A composite action exposes a `message` input and executes one shell step. Inputs are passed through an environment variable.
